The @w3c/GS1 workshop on "E-Commerce for Humans and AI Agents" is happening today and tomorrow in #Zurich 🇨🇭 , bringing together 90+ participants on site and many more online to explore how #AIAgents are, and will be, interacting with Web content, through the specific lens of #Ecommerce.

▶️ https://www.w3.org/2026/ecommerce-agents/agenda.html

Thanks to our host, Google, and sponsors Google, #gs1 and Visa!
